closed.profile____: On Day 11, Marek Profile arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Marek Profile during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Marek Profile tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
colt.d.ramsey: Zeno Ramsey unpacked a lock of hair in a matchbox at S-F17. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Zeno Ramsey watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Otto Carlingiti and Zeno Ramsey split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Zeno Ramsey heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.

A bullet clipped Zeno Ramsey's helmet at S-F17 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Bram Archiegregor of the Concord (@archiegregorysmith). On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Zeno Ramsey wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
The medics cleaned Zeno Ramsey's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F17.
Zeno Ramsey found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Zeno Ramsey saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.
Zeno Ramsey reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Felix "Spark" Toastybweady of the Concord (@toastybweady).

Zeno Ramsey is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Zeno Ramsey did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A round went through Zeno Ramsey's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Valentin "Bones" Lonerius of the Concord (@captain_lonerius). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Ramsey is number 180. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Zeno Ramsey walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Zeno Ramsey walked back up the communication trench to S-F17, slower than before, but on his own feet.
dallas106931: Dorian "Saint" Dallas came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

The whole squad at S-R7 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Dorian "Saint" Dallas's bullet that found Gideon Willskeltony, gravely wounded. Blackwater Canal has been won. Dorian "Saint" Dallas listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Dorian "Saint" Dallas was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R7. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Jakub "Whistle" Sergio of the Concord (@micro_sergio). Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Dorian "Saint" Dallas could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Dorian "Saint" Dallas is whole again, or near enough for the line.
day_walker_mma: The quartermaster asked Teodor Mma to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Teodor Mma read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

Teodor Mma was hit in the hip at T-S9. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Roland Light of the Hegemony (@searcher.of.the.light). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Teodor Mma fell at T-S9 and never moved again. Shot by Roland Light of the Hegemony (@searcher.of.the.light).

The papers connected Bastian "Bones" Mma to Teodor Mma. The men took longer to learn Bastian "Bones" Mma's own habits, but they made the effort. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-S9 with the rations. Bastian "Bones" Mma ate while listening to the revised orders.
Nils Noaskevitch of the Hegemony lost a cap on a night patrol near the Ossuary Wood. Bastian "Bones" Mma of the Concord found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
e_thanbrown: Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a book with the last pages torn out and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Rumour reached T-F20 that the war would be over by spring. Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown has heard it before. So has everyone. Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Otto "Smokes" Thanbrown fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Matthias "Bones" Moitpan, now grazed.
erwin_schwols: Pavel Schwols came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Pavel Schwols wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Pavel Schwols and Viktor Bandit cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. Pavel Schwols got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 867. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Pavel Schwols looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A round came through the loophole Pavel Schwols was watching at R-R6 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44). Pavel Schwols was killed outright at R-R6, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44).
The papers connected Wendel Schwols to Pavel Schwols. The men took longer to learn Wendel Schwols's own habits, but they made the effort.
finland2438: Benedikt Finland came up on Day 5 carrying news from Greyhallow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Benedikt Finland sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Benedikt Finland helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Benedikt Finland helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Benedikt Finland read a theatre review while peeling supper.
Benedikt Finland was hit in the foot through his boot at R-F1. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Gustav "Spark" Echoss of the Concord (@echoss_3).
The bearers moved Benedikt Finland's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.

There was never a bed for Benedikt Finland, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F1 on his own feet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Benedikt Finland folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A supply man offered Benedikt Finland a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt Finland answered to number 322. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Benedikt Finland could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A bullet clipped Benedikt Finland's helmet at R-F1 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Henrik Tobiasweighi of the Concord (@tobiasweighill).
gndr_bliss: Pavel Bliss walked into R-S13 on Day 7 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. Pavel Bliss left the work of a stretcher bearer to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

A stretcher party needed the passage. Pavel Bliss backed into a recess with an ammunition box and stayed there until the last bearer passed. A letter from home found Pavel Bliss before the night shift. Pavel Bliss folded it small and kept it close.

Pavel Bliss of the Hegemony and Severin Guy of the Concord share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at the Drowned Farm now wait for it before they sleep. A letter from home found Pavel Bliss before the night shift. Pavel Bliss folded it small and kept it close. Pavel Bliss bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Pavel Bliss went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Pavel Bliss during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. A letter from home found Pavel Bliss before the night shift. Pavel Bliss folded it small and kept it close.

A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Pavel Bliss. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf. A letter from home found Pavel Bliss before the night shift. Pavel Bliss folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Bliss answered to number 470. Pavel Bliss walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

The men at R-S13 heard Pavel Bliss call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr of the Concord (@kelvincornbread). Pavel Bliss was killed on watch at R-S13. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Felix "Doc" Kelvincornbr of the Concord (@kelvincornbread).
The House of Bliss sent another. Dorian "Brick" Bliss, older brother of Pavel Bliss, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
luckycat2025: On Day 9 Florian Luckycat took a post at R-C7 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hates silence more than shelling, and the men liked him for it.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Florian Luckycat looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Florian Luckycat traded a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Luckycat is number 641 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C7 with the rations. Florian Luckycat ate while listening to the revised orders.
Florian Luckycat found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
lucwar665: Dorian "Hollow" Lucwar reached U-F15 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

A bullet struck Dorian "Hollow" Lucwar below the ribs at U-F15. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel). Dorian "Hollow" Lucwar was killed at U-F15 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Teodor Redflamesofs of the Hegemony (@redflamesofsteel).

The House of Lucwar sent Albin Lucwar after Dorian "Hollow" Lucwar. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Albin Lucwar wrote to a grandmother who prays for both armies that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Albin Lucwar was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at U-F15. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829). Albin Lucwar stood up to fix a loose sandbag at U-F15. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Hugo Jonesmann of the Hegemony (@jonesmann829).
Another member of the House of Lucwar reached the line: Nils Lucwar. He asked where Albin Lucwar had slept, then chose a different corner.
naturallefty: Leopold "Mole" Naturallefty was a ferryman in Belmonte until the posters went up. He came to P-F12 with a pressed cornflower, and within a day the whole squad knew that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.

The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Leopold "Mole" Naturallefty approved the method. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into P-F12. Leopold "Mole" Naturallefty has learned to walk bent double.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Leopold "Mole" Naturallefty changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
ner_small: The sergeant gave Walter Small a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 3 or any other.
Walter Small raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).
A medic checked Walter Small's dressing at S-F18 and said he would be back on his feet soon. He was already trying to stand.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Walter Small is whole again, or near enough for the line. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Walter Small helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Walter Small spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
A bullet clipped Walter Small's helmet at S-F18 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).
Walter Small no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Walter Small's ear at S-F18 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Felix "Spark" Toastybweady of the Concord (@toastybweady).

Three days with a bandage, and Walter Small is back at S-F18. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. Walter Small walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Walter Small tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. The clerk counted the names twice. Walter Small is number 233 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Victory at Grey Mill. Walter Small let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Walter Small fired at a movement across the wire at S-F18. The man went down: Wendel Tsafler, grazed.
octi_1918: The quartermaster asked Felix "Ash" Octi to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Felix "Ash" Octi helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Felix "Ash" Octi of the Hegemony and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear of the Concord have carved their names into the same post in no man's land at the Drowned Farm. It is getting crowded. Felix "Ash" Octi got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 903. The men who came later will ask about it. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Felix "Ash" Octi wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Felix "Ash" Octi was hit through the chest at R-C15. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord (@sus.danny2.0). A single shot at R-C15. Felix "Ash" Octi sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord (@sus.danny2.0).
The House of Octi sent another. Oskar Octi, cousin of Felix "Ash" Octi, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
power_armor_bob: At the depot, Norbert Bob had practised answering to his name. At S-R13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-R13, Norbert Bob listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Norbert Bob was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R13. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Gideon "Doc" Midnight of the Hegemony (@frvr_midnight). Norbert Bob got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 895. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Norbert Bob read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Norbert Bob came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
tavin_anderson: Teodor Anderson signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-C16 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C16. Teodor Anderson has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home found Teodor Anderson before the night shift. Teodor Anderson folded it small and kept it close.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Teodor Anderson aimed a step ahead and fired: Teodor Casualkriegs, grazed. Teodor Anderson got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 695. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Teodor Anderson kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet hit Teodor Anderson in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-C16. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan). Teodor Anderson was hit at R-C16 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).
A letter came with Otto "Shadow" Anderson: "I am Teodor Anderson's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
the_g_comes_alive: Casimir "Ghost" Alive left a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain behind in Kesselby and came up the line with a tin whistle. The men noticed at once that he whistles the same four notes over and over.

A newspaper reached Casimir "Ghost" Alive with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Ghost" Alive. Casimir "Ghost" Alive read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The signallers took Casimir "Ghost" Alive in on a busy morning in U-F2. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.
the_great_pyroholio: Marek "Brick" Pyroholio arrived on Day 10 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Marek "Brick" Pyroholio asked to see the second one. The barber laughed. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Marek "Brick" Pyroholio wrote to an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Marek "Brick" Pyroholio's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
